title: Full-Stack Web Development
description: A comprehensive course covering both front-end and back-end web development technologies. Students will learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, and database integration to build complete web applications. The course emphasizes hands-on project-based learning with real-world deployment scenarios.

title: Application Build & Release Automation
description: This course covers modern CI/CD pipelines, build automation tools, and release management strategies. Students gain practical experience with Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, and automated testing frameworks. Emphasis is placed on industry best practices for continuous integration and delivery.

title: Computer Networks
description: An in-depth study of computer networking concepts including the OSI model, TCP/IP protocol suite, routing algorithms, and network security. Students will work with packet analysis tools and configure network devices in simulated environments. The course prepares students for industry certifications and advanced networking roles.

title: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Master fundamental and advanced data structures including arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, and hash tables. The course covers algorithmic paradigms such as divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, and greedy algorithms. Students solve competitive programming problems and analyze time/space complexity rigorously.

title: Cloud Computing & DevOps
description: Explore cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), virtualization technologies, and major cloud platforms including AWS and Azure. The course integrates DevOps methodologies with cloud-native application development. Students work on real cloud deployments and infrastructure-as-code projects.

title: Database Management Systems
description: A thorough study of relational database design, SQL programming, normalization, and transaction management. Students also explore NoSQL databases, indexing strategies, and query optimization techniques. Hands-on labs use MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB for practical database administration.

title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Introduction to machine learning algorithms including supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning. Students implement models using Python, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow with real-world datasets. The course covers feature engineering, model evaluation, and practical deployment of ML solutions.
modules: Introduction to ML & Python for Data Science

title: Operating Systems
description: Study the core concepts of operating systems including process management, memory management, file systems, and I/O handling. Students explore scheduling algorithms, synchronization mechanisms, and deadlock prevention strategies. Lab exercises involve working with Linux kernel modules and system-level programming.
